subject: Cupid Locket
text: The Cupid Locket can be bought for 300 GP from the girl inside the house to the left in Windia, providing defense and protection against silence, confusion, and blindness.

evidence.quote:
Begin by entering the house to your left. Talk to
the girl inside to buy the Cupid Locket...For 300 GP,
you can have protection against silence status, confusion (HOORAY!), and 
blindness. It also adds to your defense, which isn't a bad deal.

subject: Windia
text: Two chests in the basement of the northeast house in Windia contain Heal Potions and bombs.

evidence.quote:
Check in the basement of the northeast house to find two chests. Inside are
some Heal Potions and bombs.

subject: Windia
text: Heal Potions are found upstairs in the residence of Otto below the inn in Windia.

evidence.quote:
The house below the inn (with the weathervane on it) is the
residence of Otto...You can go
upstairs for some Heal Potions.

subject: Windia
text: Two chests upstairs where the beds are at the inn in Windia contain Refreshers and Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
Upstairs, where the beds are,
are two chests. Inside are some Refreshers and Heal Potions.

subject: Windhole Temple
text: Heal Potions can be collected in the middle of Windhole Temple before heading out.

evidence.quote:
Get the Heal Potions in the 
middle before heading out.

subject: Mount Gale
text: A chest of Heal Potions is found by taking the second staircase on Mount Gale.

evidence.quote:
Continue along and ignore the second 
staircase unless you want a chest of Heal Potions.

subject: Mount Gale
text: A chest of Refreshers can be found across the gap to the north on Mount Gale.

evidence.quote:
If you'd like, you can go north to
find a chest of Refreshers across the gap.

subject: Apollo Helm
text: The Apollo Helm, the strongest helmet picked up, is found across the chasm on Mount Gale after defeating a Vampire.

evidence.quote:
Look north and grapple yourself across the chasm. Here, you'll find the
Apollo Helm; the strongest helmet you'll pick up. Defeat the Vampire, and take 
your prize.

subject: Dullahan
text: Dullahan is best defeated by pounding him with magic such as Meteor or White, while watching out for Doom Dance which can automatically kill a unit regardless of HP.

evidence.quote:
The best way to defeat Dullahan is through pounding him with magic.
          That means casting Meteor, White, etc...The one move you want to watch 
          out for is Doom Dance. It is capable of automatically killing one 
          of your units regardless of their HP.

subject: elevator
text: Otto tells Benjamin to hit the switches with an axe to work the elevator.

evidence.quote:
Before 
you go though, he'll tell you to hit the switches with your axe to work the
elevator.

subject: Norma
text: Norma is rescued inside Pazuzu's Tower by walking up the steps to the right and talking to her.

evidence.quote:
Now inside Pazuzu's Tower, you should see a little girl to the right. Walk up
the steps and talk to her. Well, now that you've rescued her, you might as
well continue.

subject: Pazuzu's Tower
text: Two chests blocked by a line of four monsters in Pazuzu's Tower contain 20 bombs.

evidence.quote:
A line of four monsters block two chests. You will find 
20 bombs for the picking.

subject: Pazuzu's Tower
text: A chest containing Cure Potions is located on 6F of Pazuzu's Tower near a staircase and a cracked door.

evidence.quote:
Here, you have a staircase,
a chest containing Cure Potions, and a cracked door. Pick up the Cure Potions
and continue left.

subject: Flare
text: Continuing left past the Cure Potions chest leads to a chest containing the Flare spell.

evidence.quote:
Pick up the Cure Potions
and continue left. Pop open the chest for the Flare spell!

subject: Excalibur
text: Inside the doorway guarded by a Sorcerer on the right is a chest containing the Excalibur.

evidence.quote:
First, defeat the Sorcerer blocking the one
on the right. Inside is a chest containing the... Excalibur! Now that's a
friggin' powerful weapon!!

subject: Pazuzu's Tower
text: Heal Potions and Cure Potions are found in chests beyond a cracked wall guarded by a line of Gargoyles in Pazuzu's Tower.

evidence.quote:
A line of 
Gargoyles have to be defeated before you get anywhere. Get the Heal Potions
and Cure Potions.

subject: Pazuzu's Tower
text: Heal Potions and Cure Potions can be found in chests on 2F of Pazuzu's Tower.

evidence.quote:
At the end, you should
appear on 2F...Steal some Heal
Potions and Cure Potions and leave the room.

subject: Pazuzu
text: Pazuzu is weak against wind attacks like Aero, takes heavy damage from Flare, deals 500+ damage with attacks, and counters attacks while Psychshield is up.

evidence.quote:
The birdman is weak against wind attacks, so Aero works wonders.
          Flare deals more damage though...A lot of his attacks deal 500+ damage...Psychshield
          makes it so that if you attack Pazuzu while it is up, you will eat
          a nasty counter-attack. Do not attack with his shield up for that
          very reason.

subject: Sky Coin
text: The Sky Coin is found in a chest at the top of Pazuzu's Tower after riding the elevator up.

evidence.quote:
Afterwards, Benjamin will take the elevator and ride it up to the top of 
Pazuzu's Tower...Of course, you can't forget the Sky Coin in the chest.

subject: Thunder Rock
text: Talking to Arion while he is resting in bed at Reuben's house in Fireburg grants the Thunder Rock.

evidence.quote:
Head over to Reuben's house and talk to Arion, who is 
currently resting in bed. Upon asking him about Thunder Rock, he hands it 
over to you.

subject: Mobius Crest
text: Taking the Gemini Crest warp in Spencer's Place leads to a cave where the Mobius Crest is found at the end.

evidence.quote:
Take the warp with the Gemini Crest and you'll teleport just before a
cave. Follow it through the hole you blew in the wall. At the end is the 
Mobius Crest.

subject: Captain's Cap
text: Talking to Kaeli while she is tending to Norma at Otto's House in Windia yields the Captain's Cap.

evidence.quote:
Head to Otto's House and talk to Kaeli, who is currently tending to Norma. She
will hand you the Captain's Cap to show Captain Mac.

subject: Windia
text: Stepping on the tile in the basement of the northeast house in Windia with the Mobius Crest warps Benjamin to the Ship Dock.

evidence.quote:
The key is the house at the 
northeast corner. Proceed to its basement and step on the tile. With the 
Mobius Crest, you will warp to the Ship Dock.

subject: Ship Dock
text: Pushing down the barrel blocking the upper-right corner of the center room on the ship deck reveals Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
See the barrel that's blocking the upper-right corner of the tiny center room? Push
it down and get the Heal Potions.

subject: Ship Dock
text: Heading down the middle mast and dropping between two Thanatos leads to a chest containing Heal Potions.

evidence.quote:
At the top of the rope, head left and down the middle mast. You will drop in-
between two Thanatos. Defeat either one (or both) and open the chest for some
more Heal Potions.
